decisions.decision: Separate the $214.05M historical cash-funded purchase of 84.366M XRP from approximately 388.911M XRP contributed in kind. Do not describe the full approximately 473M XRP treasury as cash purchased.
Treat the $214.05M purchase as part of the wider cash-financing history; do not add it again to the $272.6M gross closing cash proceeds.
Record the $30M notes as actual debt financing proceeds issued October 12, 2026, but do not infer that the proceeds were used to buy XRP.

Treat the Cantor ELOC as optional equity-financing capacity, not cash on hand. Preserve the prospectus's $76.8M cover/detailed figure and $80.7M summary-row discrepancy; use $74.4M only as the detailed estimated net figure under its assumptions. No draw verified.

Add a direct Evernorth-to-Coinbase principal-market relationship for XRP financial reporting. This supports Coinbase's institutional price-reference importance, but does not establish custody or exclusive execution.

BitGo is the primary custodian; SEC filing reports 100% cold storage, multisignature/HSM controls and shared $250M insurance equal to 36.9% of holdings value as of October 9. The filing does not state a 2-of-3 threshold.

Classify yield strategies and DeFi protocol participation as company-reported commenced after Closing, while keeping actual XRP amounts, protocols, counterparties and transactions unverified. Reconcile against the same filing's 100% cold-storage statement.
Classify XRP-secured financing and DeFi lending as strategic possibilities; no executed collateral transaction is established.
Record SBI Holdings as strategic investor, Ripple as contributor and RLUSD as a planned stable-value asset for XRP-based DeFi. Keep SBIC regional SME investment companies distinct from SBI Holdings.
Do not admit these capital/custody statements as market-price features yet. Preserve as fundamental event evidence pending point-in-time source validation and actual deployment verification.

unresolved_items: Identify the actual protocols and wallet addresses, if any, used for yield/DeFi activity after Closing.
Reconcile the prospectus statement that 100% of XRP was cold stored with the statement that DeFi protocol participation commenced.
Verify whether any XRP-secured loan, pledge or collateral arrangement was executed.
Verify whether the $30M note proceeds were used to acquire XRP.
Verify whether any ELOC shares were sold and whether the upfront fee was paid.
Track the annual reassessment of Coinbase as Evernorth's principal market.
Reconcile the $76.8M versus $80.7M ELOC gross-proceeds inconsistency in any subsequent filing.
